title: Hermes Agent adds Microsoft Teams integration and Collective Wisdom skill sharing
summary: Hermes Agent introduces native integration with Microsoft Teams for direct chat and channel mentions, running sandboxed agent workloads in Azure Container Apps and enabling employees to publish validated workflows to a shared team skill library.
research_notes:
Deploy or add Hermes Agent to Microsoft Teams to interact via 1:1 chat or @mentions in channels.

Delegate analytical, triage, or document drafting tasks directly to the agent in conversational threads.

Publish validated workflows as reusable skills to the Collective Wisdom library for team-wide access.

Audit and verify autonomous skills before sharing them across organizational workspaces via Collective Wisdom.

Utilize isolated container sandboxes for microVM task execution to enforce enterprise data isolation.
